name: Axe
rulesSummary: Common one-handed close combat weapon.

name: Sword

restrictions: Mounted warriors only; the current seeded fixed user is the Freelancer.

name: Halberd
rulesSummary: Close combat weapon available from the Mercenary equipment list.

name: Gromril Hammer
rulesSummary: Starting Dwarf warband Gromril version of a hammer at three times the normal weapon cost. Add the Gromril weapon save modifier to the normal hammer profile.
restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Gromril Axe

restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Gromril Dwarf Axe
rulesSummary: Starting Dwarf warband Gromril version of a Dwarf Axe at three times the normal Dwarf Axe cost. Apply Dwarf Axe Cutting Edge and Parry plus the Gromril weapon save modifier.
restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Gromril Sword
rulesSummary: Starting Dwarf warband Gromril version of a sword at three times the normal weapon cost. Use the sword Parry rule and add the Gromril weapon save modifier.
restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Gromril Double-handed Weapon
rulesSummary: Starting Dwarf warband Gromril version of a double-handed weapon at three times the normal weapon cost. Add the Gromril weapon save modifier to the normal two-handed profile.
restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Gromril Spear
rulesSummary: Starting Dwarf warband Gromril version of a spear at three times the normal weapon cost. Add the Gromril weapon save modifier to the normal spear profile.
restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Gromril Halberd
rulesSummary: Starting Dwarf warband Gromril version of a halberd at three times the normal weapon cost. Add the Gromril weapon save modifier to the normal halberd profile.
restrictions: Dwarf Warrior equipment list at warband creation; later campaign purchases use the normal trading chart.

name: Weeping Blades

restrictions: Skaven heroes equipment list only.

name: Fighting Claws

name: Disease Dagger

name: Censer
rarity: Rare 8, Skaven of Clan Pestilens only
rulesSummary: Clan Pestilens two-handed flail. It has +2 Strength in the first round of each combat, Concussion, and plague fumes that can wound models in base contact after attacks are resolved.
restrictions: Skaven of Clan Pestilens heroes equipment list only.

name: Flail

restrictions: Common for Sisters of Sigmar only.

name: Morning Star
rulesSummary: Flagellant close combat weapon.

name: Staff

restrictions: Heroines only.

rulesSummary: Heroine-only miscellaneous equipment from the Sisters list.
restrictions: Heroines only.

name: Stream of Corruption
rulesSummary: Blessing of Nurgle. Gives the Tainted One a short-ranged Strength 3 shooting attack that allows no armour save.
restrictions: Tainted Ones only, bought at recruitment. Second and later Blessings cost double.

name: Nurgle's Rot
rulesSummary: Blessing of Nurgle. The Tainted One is immune to poison and can pass Nurgle's Rot to living enemies in close combat.
restrictions: Tainted Ones only, bought at recruitment. Second and later Blessings cost double.

name: Cloud of Flies
rulesSummary: Blessing of Nurgle. Enemies fighting the Tainted One suffer a to-hit penalty in close combat.
restrictions: Tainted Ones only, bought at recruitment. Second and later Blessings cost double.

name: Bloated Foulness
rulesSummary: Blessing of Nurgle. Gives +1 Wound and +1 Toughness, but reduces Movement by 1.
restrictions: Tainted Ones only, bought at recruitment. Second and later Blessings cost double.

name: Mark of Nurgle
rulesSummary: Blessing of Nurgle. Gives +1 Wound and immunity to poison.
restrictions: Tainted Ones only, bought at recruitment. Second and later Blessings cost double.

name: Hideous
rulesSummary: Blessing of Nurgle. The Tainted One causes Fear.
restrictions: Tainted Ones only, bought at recruitment. Second and later Blessings cost double.

name: Daemon Soul
rulesSummary: Mutation. The warrior has a 4+ save against the effects of spells or prayers.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Great Claw
rulesSummary: Mutation. One arm becomes a claw that cannot carry a weapon; the warrior gains an extra hand-to-hand attack with +1 Strength.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Cloven Hoofs
rulesSummary: Mutation. The warrior gains +1 Movement.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Tentacle
rulesSummary: Mutation. In close combat the warrior can reduce one opponent's Attacks by 1, to a minimum of 1, choosing which attack is lost.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Blackblood
rulesSummary: Mutation. If the warrior loses a wound in close combat, each model in base contact suffers a Strength 3 hit; these hits cannot cause critical hits.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Spines
rulesSummary: Mutation. At the beginning of each close combat phase, every model in base contact suffers an automatic Strength 1 hit; these hits cannot cause critical hits.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Scorpion Tail
rulesSummary: Mutation. The warrior makes an extra Strength 5 hand-to-hand attack each close combat phase; against poison-immune targets this tail attack is Strength 2.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Extra Arm
rulesSummary: Mutation. The warrior may use an extra single-handed weapon for +1 Attack, or carry a shield or buckler in the extra arm. A Possessed still cannot carry weapons.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Hideous
rulesSummary: Mutation. The warrior causes Fear.
restrictions: Mutants and Possessed only, bought at recruitment. Second and later mutations on the same model cost double.

name: Squig Prodder
rulesSummary: Goblin-only spear-like weapon. Cave Squigs respect a prodder within the larger listed Minderz range.
restrictions: Common, Goblins only.

name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
rulesSummary: Goblin drug required to use a Ball and Chain; a Goblin may take the mushrooms at the start of any turn.
restrictions: Common for Orc warbands that include Goblins.

name: Ball and Chain
rulesSummary: Goblin-only heavy weapon used with Mad Cap Mushrooms. It strikes at user Strength +2, ignores armour saves and can cause multiple wounds, but moves randomly and is dangerous to the wielder.
restrictions: Common, Goblins only. Requires Mad Cap Mushrooms.

name: Elf Bow
rulesSummary: Range 36 inches, Strength 3 missile weapon with a -1 armour save modifier.
restrictions: Available from the Shadow Warrior equipment list; rare outside creation.

name: Ithilmar Dagger
rulesSummary: Ithilmar version of a dagger at the Shadow Warrior creation cost; grants +1 Initiative in hand-to-hand combat.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation; app models the listed 2x weapon price as a separate item.

name: Ithilmar Sword
rulesSummary: Ithilmar version of a sword at the Shadow Warrior creation cost; grants +1 Initiative in hand-to-hand combat.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation; app models the listed 2x weapon price as a separate item.

name: Ithilmar Spear
rulesSummary: Ithilmar version of a spear at the Shadow Warrior creation cost; grants +1 Initiative in hand-to-hand combat.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation; app models the listed 2x weapon price as a separate item.

name: Ithilmar Double-handed Weapon
rulesSummary: Ithilmar version of a double-handed weapon at the Shadow Warrior creation cost; grants +1 Initiative in hand-to-hand combat.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation; app models the listed 2x weapon price as a separate item.

name: Ithilmar Armour
rulesSummary: 5+ armour save. It does not reduce Movement when combined with a shield.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation.

name: Standard of Nagarythe
rulesSummary: Second rally point for Shadow Warriors within 12 inches; if captured, the warband gains Hatred for the rest of the game and may not voluntarily rout.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only; may only be bought when the warband is created.

name: War Horn of Nagarythe
rulesSummary: Once per game at the start of a Shadow Warrior turn, all members gain +1 Leadership, up to 10, until the start of the next turn.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation.

name: Elven Cloak
rulesSummary: Enemy shooting attacks suffer an additional -1 to hit the wearer.
restrictions: Available from the Shadow Warrior equipment list.

name: Elven Wine
rulesSummary: One-use item. A Shadow Warrior warband that drinks it before a battle is immune to Fear for that battle.
restrictions: Shadow Warrior heroes only at creation; one use only.

name: Elven Runestones
rulesSummary: A mage may attempt to dispel a spell cast against himself or another warband member by matching the casting score.
restrictions: Shadow Weavers only at creation.

name: Stone Axe
rulesSummary: Lizardmen stone axe that counts as a club.
restrictions: Lizardmen equipment lists only.

name: Light Armour
rulesSummary: Lizardmen light armour at the warband's listed 50 gc cost; adds +1 to Scaly Skin saves.
restrictions: Lizardmen armour is rare and always costs 50 gc.

name: Bone Helmet
rulesSummary: Lizardmen helmet; Skink Priests and Saurus may use it from their equipment lists.
restrictions: Saurus equipment list, and Skink Priest only from the Skinks list.

name: Bolas
rulesSummary: Range 16 inch one-use missile weapon. It entangles rather than wounds and is recovered after the battle.
restrictions: Common, Lizardmen only.

name: Javelin
rulesSummary: Range 8 inch thrown spear using the thrower's Strength; no range or moving penalties.
restrictions: Common missile weapon for Skinks and similar hunters.

name: Throwing Knives
rulesSummary: Thrown missile weapon available in selected warband equipment lists.

name: Blowpipe
rarity: Rare 7, Lizardmen and Forest Goblins only
rulesSummary: Blowpipe from the Lizardmen equipment list; use the core blowpipe weapon rules.
restrictions: Skinks equipment list only.

name: Dark Venom
rulesSummary: Common Lizardmen poison purchase for Skink heroes; may only be used on missile weapons.
restrictions: Skink heroes only; missile weapons only.

name: Black Lotus
rulesSummary: Common Lizardmen poison purchase for Skink heroes; may only be used on missile weapons.
restrictions: Skink heroes only; missile weapons only.

name: Reptile Venom
rulesSummary: One-battle Skink henchman poison for missile weapons. Adds +1 Strength but no additional save modifier.
restrictions: Skink henchmen missile weapons only; henchman groups must be armed uniformly.

name: Oversized Jaws
rulesSummary: Sacred Marking. The Saurus hero's bite attack gains +1 Strength.
restrictions: Saurus heroes only; only one Sacred Marking per hero and bought at recruitment.

name: Poison Glands
rulesSummary: Sacred Marking. The Skink hero may make bite attacks instead of weapon attacks; those bites improve injury rolls.
restrictions: Skink heroes only; only one Sacred Marking per hero and bought at recruitment.

name: Mark of the Old Ones
rulesSummary: Sacred Marking. Once per battle, the hero may change one failed roll into a success for an action he is making himself.
restrictions: Lizardmen heroes only; only one Sacred Marking per hero and bought at recruitment.

name: Kroxigor Halberd
rulesSummary: The Kroxigor is equipped with a halberd; its cost is included in the Kroxigor hire cost.
restrictions: Kroxigor only.

name: Spear
rulesSummary: Forest Goblin spear bought at the warband's listed cost. It uses spear rules including striking first in the first round of hand-to-hand combat.
restrictions: Forest Goblin equipment lists only.

name: Boss Pole
rulesSummary: Forest Goblin hero badge of office. It acts as a spear and lets the hero and Goblin henchmen within 6 inches ignore Animosity.
restrictions: Common, Forest Goblin heroes only.

name: Blowpipe
rulesSummary: Range 8 inch Strength 1 missile weapon with Poison and Stealthy. It improves the target's armour save by +1 and cannot cause critical hits.
restrictions: Common for Forest Goblins.

name: Throwing Weapons
rulesSummary: Forest Goblin thrown weapons. Sluggas may throw these up to three times in the shooting phase.
restrictions: Forest Goblin henchmen equipment list.

name: Poisoned Weapon
rulesSummary: Forest Goblin poison purchase applied to one weapon. That weapon adds +1 to injury rolls and may not be traded or sold later.
restrictions: Common, Forest Goblins only. The app records this as one poisoned weapon note; choose the affected weapon in notes.

name: Magic Gubbinz
rulesSummary: Shaman focus items. The Shaman may re-roll a failed magic test on a D6 roll of 4+.
restrictions: Forest Goblin Shaman only.

name: Red Toof Tribal Jewellery
rulesSummary: Permanent body-piercing trophy that makes the model subject to Frenzy.
restrictions: Forest Goblins only; cannot be removed once bought.

name: Riding/Draft Horse
rulesSummary: Optional mounted rules. Human Hero mount with profile M8 WS1 BS0 S3 T3 W1 I3 A0 Ld5. It gives the standard mounted armour-save bonus but does not attack in close combat.
restrictions: Optional mounted combat rules. Human Heroes only.

name: Warhorse
rulesSummary: Optional mounted rules. Human Hero combat mount with profile M8 WS3 BS0 S3 T3 W1 I3 A1 Ld5. Battle Schooled lets the rider re-roll one failed loss of control test.
restrictions: Optional mounted combat rules. Human Heroes and fixed mounted hired swords only.

name: Barding
rulesSummary: Optional mounted rules. Warhorse armour adds a further +1 armour save bonus to the mounted model, reduces the mount's Movement by 1, and makes the warhorse die only on a serious injury roll of 1 if the rider goes out of action.
restrictions: Warhorse only.

name: Nightmare
rulesSummary: Optional Blazing Saddles mount. Undead mount with profile M8 WS2 BS0 S3 T3 W1 I2 A1 Ld5. It may not run, is immune to poison and psychology, and uses the mounted warrior rules.
restrictions: Optional mounted combat rules. Vampires and Necromancers only.

name: War Boar
rulesSummary: Optional Blazing Saddles mount. Orc mount with profile M7 WS3 BS0 S3 T4 W1 I3 A1 Ld3. Its own attack gains +2 Strength on the charge and it gives the rider an additional +1 armour save bonus.
restrictions: Optional mounted combat rules. Orc Heroes only.

name: Cold One
rulesSummary: Optional Blazing Saddles mount. Lizardmen mount with profile M7 WS3 BS0 S4 T4 W1 I3 A1 Ld3. It causes Fear, is subject to Stupidity, and gives the rider an additional +1 armour save bonus.
restrictions: Optional mounted combat rules. Lizardmen Heroes only.

name: Elven Steed
rulesSummary: Optional Blazing Saddles mount. Elf mount with profile M9 WS3 BS0 S3 T3 W1 I4 A1 Ld5. Battle Schooled lets the rider re-roll one failed loss of control test.
restrictions: Optional mounted combat rules. Shadow Warrior Heroes only in the current seeded warbands.

name: Giant Spider
rulesSummary: Forest Goblin spider mount. Profile M7 WS3 BS0 S3(4) T3 W1 I4 A1 Ld4 with poisoned attacks and Wall Walk.
restrictions: Goblin spider mount; full mounted-rider handling remains manual.

name: Double-barrelled Pistol
rulesSummary: Blackpowder pistol variant. Each successful shot causes two Strength 4 hits, but each barrel takes a full turn to reload.
restrictions: Jaeger equipment list only in the current seeded warbands.

name: Brace of Double-barrelled Pistols
rulesSummary: A pair of double-barrelled pistols. Each successful shot causes two Strength 4 hits; with a brace, the warrior may fire them every other round because both barrels still reload separately.
restrictions: Jaeger equipment list only in the current seeded warbands.

name: Double-barrelled Hunting Rifle
rulesSummary: Hunting rifle variant. Each successful shot causes two hits instead of one, but each barrel takes a full turn to reload.
restrictions: Jaeger equipment list only in the current seeded warbands.

name: Vodka
rulesSummary: One-use Kislevite Hero item used before a game. The warband gains +1 Leadership for the battle, max 10, but each member tests Toughness or suffers -1 Initiative for the battle.
restrictions: Kislevite Heroes only; bought from the Trading Post, not the starting equipment list. Cost is base 35 gc plus 2D6 gc.

name: Bear-Claw Necklace
rulesSummary: Kislevite Hero item. The wearer is subject to Frenzy.
restrictions: Kislevite Heroes only; bought from the Trading Post, not the starting equipment list. Cost is base 75 gc plus 3D6 gc.

name: Starblade

restrictions: Amazons (Lustria) equipment lists only.

name: Starsword
rulesSummary: Lustria Amazon close-combat weapon. Strength as user +1, may parry, and ignores armour saves except ward and dodge saves.
restrictions: Amazons (Lustria) equipment lists only.

name: Claw of the Old Ones
rulesSummary: Mordheim Amazon close-combat artefact. Strength as user +1 and wounds allow no armour save.
restrictions: Amazons (Mordheim) heroine equipment list only.

name: Sling
rulesSummary: Amazon equipment-list sling bought at the listed Amazon recruitment cost.
restrictions: Amazon henchwomen and scouts/Jaguar Warriors only.

name: Bolas
rulesSummary: Range 16 inch one-use missile weapon. It entangles rather than wounds and is recovered after the battle.
restrictions: Amazons (Lustria) Jaguar Warrior equipment list only.

name: Javelins
rulesSummary: Amazon javelins bought at the listed Amazon recruitment cost; use the javelin thrown-weapon rules.
restrictions: Amazon Scout or Jaguar Warrior equipment lists only.

name: Sunstaff (Lustria)
rulesSummary: Lustria Amazon artefact. In shooting it fires a 12 inch Strength 4 Sunbolt that ignores armour saves except ward and dodge saves and ignores long-range penalties.
restrictions: Amazons (Lustria) equipment lists only.

name: Sunstaff
rulesSummary: Mordheim Amazon artefact. Range 24 inches, Strength 4, accurate at long range, and wounds allow no armour save.
restrictions: Amazons (Mordheim) heroine equipment list only.

name: Sun Gauntlet
rulesSummary: Mordheim Amazon artefact. Range 12 inches, Strength 4, accurate at long range, no armour saves, and can be used as a close-combat bonus attack with another weapon.
restrictions: Amazons (Mordheim) heroine equipment list only.

name: Amulet of the Moon
rulesSummary: Ancient Amazon amulet. Missile attacks against the wearer suffer -1 to hit, and the wearer has a 5+ special save against missile fire.
restrictions: Amazons (Lustria) heroine equipment list only.

name: Amulet of the Moon
rulesSummary: Ancient Amazon amulet. Missile attacks against the wearer suffer -1 to hit, and the wearer has a 5+ special save against missile fire.
restrictions: Amazons (Mordheim) heroine equipment list only.

name: Enchanted Skins
rulesSummary: Lustria Amazon protective skins and charms. The wearer has a 6+ special save against wounds and resists enemy magic on a 5+.
restrictions: Amazons (Lustria) equipment lists only.

name: Conch Shell Horn

restrictions: Piranha Warriors only.

name: Healing Herbs
rulesSummary: Amazon herbalist equipment bought as a common item from the Amazon lists; use the normal Healing Herbs recovery rules.
restrictions: Amazon heroine equipment lists only at recruitment.

name: Pistol (Nuln)

restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only.

rulesSummary: Discounted Gunnery School brace of pistols. For this app's warband creation weapon limits, a brace counts as one missile weapon.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only.

name: Duelling Pistol (Nuln)
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln
rulesSummary: Discounted Gunnery School duelling pistol. Range 10 inches, Strength 4, +1 to hit, save modifier -2, Prepare Shot and hand-to-hand pistol rules.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment list only.

name: Brace of Duelling Pistols (Nuln)
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln
rulesSummary: Discounted Gunnery School brace of duelling pistols. For this app's warband creation weapon limits, a brace counts as one missile weapon.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment list only.

name: Handgun (Nuln)
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln
rulesSummary: Discounted Gunnery School handgun. Range 24 inches, Strength 4, save modifier -2, Move or Fire and Prepare Shot.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only.

name: Double-Barrelled Pistol
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln; Rare 9 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln blackpowder pistol. Range 6 inches, Strength 4, save modifier -2, Prepare Shot, hand-to-hand pistol rules and Double-Barrelled firing.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only at the listed starting cost.

name: Brace of Double-Barrelled Pistols
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln; Rare 10 otherwise
rulesSummary: Brace of Nuln double-barrelled pistols. For this app's warband creation weapon limits, a brace counts as one missile weapon.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only at the listed starting cost.

name: Double-Barrelled Duelling Pistol
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln; Rare 11 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln duelling pistol with two barrels. Range 9 inches, Strength 4, +1 to hit, save modifier -2, Prepare Shot, hand-to-hand pistol rules and Double-Barrelled firing.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment list only at the listed starting cost.

name: Brace of Double-Barrelled Duelling Pistols
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln; Rare 12 otherwise
rulesSummary: Brace of Nuln double-barrelled duelling pistols. For this app's warband creation weapon limits, a brace counts as one missile weapon.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment list only at the listed starting cost.

name: Double-Barrelled Handgun
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln; Rare 10 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln handgun with two barrels. Range 24 inches, Strength 4, save modifier -2, Move or Fire, Prepare Shot and Double-Barrelled firing.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only at the listed starting cost.

name: Repeater Pistol
rarity: Common for Gunnery School Marksmen; Rare 9 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln specialist pistol. Range 6 inches, Strength 4, save modifier -2, Fire Thrice, Experimental, Quick Reload and Not a Club.
restrictions: Marksman equipment list only at the listed starting cost.

name: Repeater Handgun
rarity: Common for Gunnery School Marksmen; Rare 11 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln specialist handgun. Range 24 inches, Strength 4, save modifier -2, Move or Fire, Fire Thrice, Experimental and Slow Reload.
restrictions: Marksman equipment list only at the listed starting cost.

name: Hand-Held Mortar
rarity: Common for Gunnery School Marksmen; Rare 12 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln explosive blackpowder weapon. Range 24 inches, Strength 4, save modifier -2, Prepare Shot, Move or Fire, Scatter, Experimental and Explosive Radius.
restrictions: Marksman equipment list only at the listed starting cost.

name: Hersten-Wenkler Pigeon Bombs
rarity: Common for Gunnery School Marksmen; Rare 8 otherwise
rulesSummary: Nuln explosive equipment with unlimited range. Resolve hits with Temperamental, Explosive Radius and Pigeon Roost; it is Move or Fire.
restrictions: Marksman equipment list only at the listed starting cost.

name: Superior Black Powder
rarity: Common for Gunnery School of Nuln
rulesSummary: Gunnery School supply item for blackpowder weapons. Record which weapon it is assigned to and use the source rule when firing.
restrictions: Gunnery School equipment lists only.

name: Cat o' Nine Tails
rulesSummary: Pirate whip weapon. Strength as user, -1 armour save modifier, cannot be parried, and gives +1 Attack in the turn the wielder charges.
restrictions: Pirate and Gunner equipment lists only.

name: Boat Hook
rulesSummary: Boatswain two-handed close-combat weapon. Strength as user and strikes first.
restrictions: Boatswains only.

name: Rope and Hook
rulesSummary: The warrior may re-roll failed Initiative tests when climbing up or down, but cannot use the hook while running.
restrictions: Pirate warband equipment lists only.

name: Toughened Leathers
rulesSummary: Gives a 6+ armour save. It can be combined with other armour, but may not improve the armour save beyond 5+.
restrictions: Pirate warband equipment lists only.

name: Swivel Gun
rulesSummary: Range 24 inches, Strength 5, -2 armour save modifier. It is Move or Fire, requires Prepare Shot, uses special ammunition and is Unwieldy.
restrictions: Pirate Gunners only. Buy and record Ball Shot, Chain Shot or Grape Shot ammunition separately.

name: Swivel Gun Ball Shot
rulesSummary: Swivel Gun ammunition. Range 24 inches, Strength 5, -2 armour save modifier, Move or Fire, Prepare Shot, Concussion and Unwieldy.
restrictions: Pirate Gunners with a Swivel Gun only.

name: Swivel Gun Chain Shot
rulesSummary: Swivel Gun ammunition. Range 24 inches, Strength 4, -1 armour save modifier, Move or Fire, Prepare Shot, Dangerous and Unwieldy.
restrictions: Pirate Gunners with a Swivel Gun only.

name: Swivel Gun Grape Shot
rulesSummary: Swivel Gun ammunition. Range 24 inches, Strength 3, -1 armour save modifier, Move or Fire, Prepare Shot, Fire Twice and Unwieldy.
restrictions: Pirate Gunners with a Swivel Gun only.

name: Repeater Crossbow
rulesSummary: Dark Elf repeater crossbow. Range 24 inches, Strength 3, save modifier -1. May fire multiple shots as described in the weapon rules.

name: Dark Elf Blade
rulesSummary: Weapon upgrade for a sword or dagger. Adds +1 to critical hit rolls and changes injury roll results of 2-4 to Stunned.
restrictions: Heroes only. Upgrades an existing sword or dagger at time of purchase.

name: Sea Dragon Cloak
rulesSummary: Special cloak made from sea dragon hide. Provides a 5+ armour save in close combat and a 4+ armour save against missile attacks.
restrictions: Heroes and Corsairs only. May be worn with other armour (provides improved save).

name: Beastlash
rulesSummary: Beastmaster whip. Causes Fear in animals, cannot be parried, grants +1 Attack on a charge. Beastmaster only.
restrictions: Beastmaster only.

name: Dark Venom
rulesSummary: A dose of potent Dark Elf poison. Applied to a hand-to-hand weapon before battle. A model wounded by the poisoned weapon must roll 4+ to recover from Stunned or Knocked Down results.
restrictions: Heroes only.
